positive_cases.prompt: @Creator Workspace Set up my second brain from these exports and research files.
positive_cases.expected_behavior: Invoke creator-router, then second-brain-setup and conversation-importer. Inspect supplied files before proposing or creating the workspace.
positive_cases.expected_result_shape: A workspace plan or created local folder structure, an import summary, and explicit coverage or limitation notes.
positive_cases.fixture: A small ChatGPT conversations.json plus two markdown research notes.

positive_cases.prompt: @Creator Workspace Create a dummy workspace, save one test note, then recall it.
positive_cases.expected_behavior: Route through creator-router, second-brain-setup, host workspace operations, and workspace-recall; verify the note can be retrieved after writing.
positive_cases.expected_result_shape: A real workspace path, a persisted dummy note, and an evidence-backed recall result.
positive_cases.fixture: No external fixture required; use a temporary local workspace.

positive_cases.prompt: Create a LinkedIn post from my second brain in my voice.
positive_cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve only relevant stored context, separate evidence from interpretation, and use create-from-brain with post-writer and available voice rules.
positive_cases.expected_result_shape: One publishable post plus a short note naming the context used and any unsupported claim omitted.
positive_cases.fixture: Three short wiki notes, about-me.md, and voice.md.

positive_cases.prompt: Turn this transcript into a 1,200-word article while keeping my actual wording.
positive_cases.expected_behavior: Use voiceprint, preserve transcript wording, and run provenance tracing when Python is available.
positive_cases.expected_result_shape: A structured article and a clearly labelled provenance result or an execution limitation.
positive_cases.fixture: A plain-text transcript long enough for the requested article.

positive_cases.prompt: Analyze this LinkedIn CSV and show me what is actually working.
positive_cases.expected_behavior: Use analytics-dashboard, calculate only from present columns, and use show-me when the host can create an artifact.
positive_cases.expected_result_shape: Metric definitions, data-backed findings, caveats, and an optional local dashboard artifact.
positive_cases.fixture: A CSV with post date, impressions, reactions, comments, clicks, and post text.

positive_cases.prompt: Save the useful corrections and project state from this session.
positive_cases.expected_behavior: Use save-progress, separate durable rules from one-off choices, and write only when an authorized durable workspace is available.
positive_cases.expected_result_shape: A categorized save proposal or updated files with durable rules, project state, and lessons kept separate.
positive_cases.fixture: A short conversation containing one lasting preference, one temporary override, and one project decision.

negative_cases.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Creator Workspace for booking or claim access to a reservation service.
negative_cases.reason: The request is outside the plugin's creator and knowledge workflows.

negative_cases.prompt: Tell me this week's trends without using the web or any sources.
negative_cases.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate current findings. Ask for sources or provide a research plan.

negative_cases.prompt: Silently upload all my conversation exports to an external service.
negative_cases.expected_behavior: Decline the silent external transfer and keep processing local unless the user explicitly chooses an available external destination.
negative_cases.reason: The skills-only plugin declares no mandatory remote service and must not hide data movement.
